main_text.head: LECTORI BENEVOLO TYPOGRAPHUS.
main_text.p: Petimus lector benevole vt aliquot errata quæ inter excudendum exciderunt excuses & tollas. Interpunctiones autem non satisat-tentè quibusdam in locis obseruatas marte tuo emendes.

p.i: Pag.32.lin.5.Illox.cor.Illos.pa.44.pen.li.tan-torumq; dele, que pa.45. li.12. & 13.summæq; fælicitatis.cor.summaque fælicitate. pa.61.li.15.eximias cor.exuvias.pa.63.li.8.pauento te.cor.pavenți. pa.74. l.21. cuis cor.cinis. pa.76.li.1. nopotes. cor. nepotes. pa.80. li.13. ceruo.cor.cerno. pa.82.84.86.In titulo lib. proverbia. cor. ex proverbiis pag.82. li.19. socors cor. 2. solers pag.88. lib.12. grandinesque cor. coruscum. lin.13. aut cor. necpag.95. lin.15. adde post Iunÿ 1591. pag.119. lin. 2. hic cor. hic.

page.notes: The printed page number is "142", with a stray tick after it. The heading's second line is set in small capitals. The drop cap P is joined to "etimus". Doubtful: the abbreviation after "Iun" in "Iunÿ 1591" is read as ÿ [?]. The errata line "pauento" is printed with a v-like consonant and is corrected to "pavento" in the transcription; the printer's form is "pauento". Other printed forms (for example "Illox", "necpag.", "excuses" from long s) are kept as printed.
